name: Impossible Dip
steps: Grip the parallel bars and support yourself on straight arms with your shoulders slightly behind your hands.
Keep your legs straight and still beneath you with your core tightly braced.
Bend your elbows back and lower your forearms toward the bars, keeping your shoulders behind your hands.
Without swinging or leaning forward, press strictly through your triceps to straighten your arms back to the top support position.
tips: Avoid kipping with your legs or rocking your shoulders forward over your hands as you press up.
Progress range of motion gradually because the strict leverage places intense load on the triceps tendons.
